headlines.text: Trump says Morocco named Tiznit-Dakhla highway after him: Why it matters. The claimed tribute to Trump forms part of Morocco's larger ambitions in the disputed Western Sahara.
Clashes near Morocco’s border with Spain over beefed up migrant security. Clashes erupted near the Morocco-Spain border crossing, after thousands of migrants into Spain.
Pacific island nation Nauru officially changes name to ‘Naoero’. The switch honours a name lost to colonial rule more than a century ago.
‘They got trapped:’ Race to save miners after deadly blast in Pakistan. Emergency workers are digging to get oxygen into a mine after an explosion in Pakistan's Balochistan Province.
Israeli soldiers mutiny at notorious Sde Teiman base. Dozens of Israeli soldiers have abandoned their weapons and walked out of the Sde Teiman military base.
Spain deploys military to Ceuta after deadly migrant surge. Spain has deployed its military to Ceuta after thousands of migrants overwhelmed police barricades.
Nepal’s PM urges calm as three people killed after Hindu-Muslim unrest. Three dead in violence in Nepal, as authorities enforce curfews and pledge to restore 'peace and unity'.
London protesters march through streets in solidarity with Azad Kashmir. Protesters in London marched from Hyde Park towards the Pakistan High Commission on Thursday.
US Escalation with Iran is ‘pointless’, warns former US diplomat. As US-Iran clashes escalate, former US Ambassador to UAE Barbara Leaf warns escalation is ‘fairly pointless’.
Iran war live: Gaza Board of Peace lauds ‘historic’ disarmament agreement. Hamas member told Al Jazeera all implementation would be conditioned on Israel implementing its part of deal.
Trump announces Hamas to disarm paving way for Israel to withdraw from Gaza. US President Donald Trump said on TruthSocial that an agreement has been reached for Hamas to fully disarm.
UK left-wing MP Diane Abbott reinstated by Labour Party after suspension. Diane Abbott returns to Labour, a year after her suspension over comments about racism.
Pathirage challenges Chopra-Nadeem javelin rivalry in Commonwealth final. Sri Lanka's Rumesh Pathirage is favourite ahead of rivalry between India's Neeraj Chopra and Pakistan's Arshad Nadeem.
US appeals court rejects Trump expansion of mandatory migrant detention. Appeals court rules that the Trump administration cannot deny detained migrants the chance for release on bond.
Trump administration appeals to never-before-used court for deportation. US government prosecutors are seeking the removal of Nazira Haji Zada, though she faces no criminal charges.

Montana’s plan to become an experimental medical hub just pushed forward. As of this week in Montana, any biotech company with an experimental drug has a clear path to selling it to consumers. Companies whose drugs have been through preliminary testing—sometimes in as few as 10 healthy people—can pay $12,500 to apply to a newly established review board for approval. 49ers bring back Deebo Samuel to fill void left by Ricky Pearsall's knee injury: report. Deebo Samuel agreed to a one-year deal worth up to $7 million to rejoin the San Francisco 49ers after Ricky Pearsall suffered a knee injury.

Mystery stranger vanishes after family says frantic warning saved their lives during devastating house fire. The Las Vegas family is now searching for the unidentified hero they say woke them during a July 5 house fire they believe was caused by fireworks.

Spain deploys military after thousands of migrants overwhelm border enclave, at least 9 dead. Video shows thousands of migrants overwhelming Ceuta's Tarajal border as Spain deploys its military and at least nine people die during crossings.

Rockets' Tari Eason says ex-girlfriend ruined $92K wardrobe with bleach, threatened to kill him in filing. Tari Eason alleges his ex-girlfriend punched him, poured bleach on $92,000 worth of designer clothing and threatened to kill him in court filings.

Ex-CBS reporter claims questioning Fauci got her 'pulled off air' during COVID pandemic. Former CBS News journalist Brittney Hopper claimed she was pulled off the air for questioning Dr. Anthony Fauci's recommendations during COVID-19.

Falcons announce defensive coordinator Jeff Ulbrich's wife Cristina died after battle with cancer. Cristina Ulbrich, the wife of Falcons defensive coordinator Jeff Ulbrich, died Sunday after a courageous battle with cancer, the team announced.

Nancy Guthrie update: DNA couldn't be profiled from crime scene hair sample, sheriff says. DNA testing on a hair sample found in Nancy Guthrie's home returned no profile, but investigators say the sample may still prove valuable as the case continues.

GOP gubernatorial candidate fighting to flip blue state unveils healthcare plan to lower costs, expand access. Massachusetts GOP hopeful Mike Minogue outlines a healthcare overhaul centered on innovation, outpatient care, mental health and cutting waste.

Apple prices just went up — these refurbished MacBooks, iPads and Apple Watches cost far less. Apple's recent price hikes make refurbished Apple devices an even better value. Shop MacBooks, iPads and Apple Watches from $142.

Sen Mark Kelly warns far-left policies that ‘don’t make sense’ could cost Democrats seats. Sen. Mark Kelly said far-left calls to abolish police, eliminate prisons and defund the Pentagon are dragging down Democratic Party approval ratings.

WATCH: GOP holdout rejects Trump threat as AG nominee standoff explodes. Thom Tillis dismissed Trump's threat to withdraw Todd Blanche's nomination for attorney general, saying the White House must honor a prior commitment.

Influencer accused of targeting wealthy dating app matches back behind bars. Adva Lavie, also known as Mia Ventura, allegedly cut her ankle monitor while awaiting trial on dating app burglary charges targeting wealthy victims.

WNBA fans call out glaring double standard after Angel Reese’s clueless response to Paige Bueckers bet. Angel Reese said she'd be requesting her Apple Pay after the Dream's win over the Wings, brushing off criticism of her $400 bet with Paige Bueckers.

Mamdani's 'this is only the beginning' announcement cracking down on food delivery tips sparks outrage. New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani faced viral backlash Thursday over a post claiming responsibility for increasing food delivery service tips.

Washington Capitals star Alex Ovechkin crashes a couple's wedding photo shoot on a hotel staircase. Video captures Alex Ovechkin casually strolling into a couple's wedding photo shoot in Saint Petersburg with a CCM hockey stick in his hands.
Mortgage rates hit their highest level in a year, driven by war and inflation concerns. The 30-year fixed-rate mortgage reached 6.66% on average Thursday.

After Fauci Senate hearing, experts worry about 'chilling effect' on public health. The accusations against Dr. Anthony Fauci, once the nation's leading infectious disease expert, have some experts worrying that these events may further erode public health staffing in the U.S.

The Trump administration wants $10 million more to cover its July Fourth celebrations. Congress allocated $150 million for 250th birthday events. The Trump-backed group that planned the state fair and July 4th fireworks is asking for an additional $10 million in reimbursements.

Are you choosing to stay single? We want to hear from you. Solo living, solo travel, and solo dining are all being embraced as more adults are choosing to remain single. Many Americans aren't interested in dating, and being single is a symbol of autonomy.

European soccer leaders to boycott  the World Cup in an unprecedented step. In an unprecedented step, European soccer associations said they would boycott the World Cup unless FIFA reverses a controversial deal to sell minority stakes to the marquee soccer tournament.
Trump says he 'may' pull Blanche AG nomination temporarily. The news comes as two key Republicans are withholding their support over concerns about the Justice Department's deal with President Trump.

The economy slowed a bit -- but Americans continued to spend. The U.S. economy grew at an annual rate of 1.5% in the spring, according to the Commerce Department. That's a modest slowdown from the previous quarter — but consumer spending picked up steam.

Alien Terrorist Removal Court holds its first-ever hearing after 30 years. Congress created the Alien Terrorist Removal Court in 1996 to make it easier for the Justice Department to use classified evidence to deport people from U.S. soil.

Sen. Paul threatens to hold Fauci in contempt. And, a new rule undercuts U.S. asylum. Sen. Rand Paul is moving to hold Dr. Anthony Fauci in contempt of Congress after he invoked his Fifth Amendment rights. And, the Trump administration has announced a new rule for the asylum process.

Russian strikes across Ukraine kill 10 and a missile falls in Poland. A Russian missile and drone barrage across Ukraine killed at least 10 civilians, including children, and NATO scrambled jets after one of the missiles crossed the border into Poland.
